subject: HelixHealth MSA / Order Form — security exhibit and pen-test cadence
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: MSA / Order Form — security exhibit ask and pen-test window

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As we move the MSA + Order Form through procurement at HelixHealth, legal has asked for a concrete security exhibit that covers two things up front: (1) SOC 2 attestation and a summary of scope, and (2) a pen-test/assessment clause that specifies notice windows, scope (external vs. internal), and evidence cadence.

Attached is a short questionnaire our procurement team completed — it lists the baseline asks. We need:
- the SOC 2 report (redacted) or a one-page summary showing scope and assertion period;
- proposed pen-test language we can include in the order form (preferably brief, vendor-friendly language with a 30/60/90 day notice pattern for scheduling);
- confirmation of where audit evidence (logs, SOC artifacts) will be stored and how long Redwood retains them for a customer request.

Can you pull together a recommended exhibit and sample redlines we can hand to legal by EOD Wednesday? Procurement would like to align the audit window to a quarterly evidence cadence if possible.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Director, Procurement — HelixHealth

Attachments: Helix_MSA_questions.xlsx
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — security exhibit ask and pen-test window

Thanks Daniel — looping in Connor (product infra) and Laura (legal) so we can provide a concise set of deliverables. Quick plan below.

Summary / proposed deliverables:
1) SOC 2: we will send a redacted SOC 2 Type II report summary (attestation period 2024-07 through 2025-07) plus a one-page cover note that lists in-scope systems (hosted API, dedicated runtime) and the high-level control boundaries. Expect that artifact by EOD Tuesday.

2) Pen-test language: Laura, see draft request: we propose an Order Form appendix that:
   - allows HelixHealth up to one (1) annual external penetration test without separate approval, with 30 days' notice;
   - defines "external" as customer-facing endpoints and excludes internal infra;
   - requires Redwood to provide remediation status and a summary report within 30 days of completion;
   - adds an evidence cadence clause: quarterly evidence windows for artifact handoff (logs, patching attestations) and a 2-business-day SLA for ad hoc evidence requests tied to open tickets.

3) Evidence storage & retention: Redwood stores SOC artifacts and audit logs in a secure document repository (customer-scoped bucket) with 12 months of active retention and archived copies retained for 36 months unless longer retention is required by an enterprise contract. We'll include the KMS/HSM note.

Action items / timeline:
- Naomi: assemble SOC2 one-pager + redact (deliver by Tue 2026-05-25).
- Laura: draft appendix language and quick redline to the standard Order Form (deliver by EOD 2026-05-20).
- Connor: confirm whether the quarterly evidence windows and 2-business-day ad hoc SLA are operationally feasible and flag any constraints (today).

If this plan looks OK, Laura can attach the redlines and I will send a single packaged response to your legal and procurement teams.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Strategic GTM Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft redlines for HelixHealth — pen test + SOC2 exhibit

Naomi — draft attached. High-level notes inline:

- I tightened the pen-test clause to avoid open-ended obligations (we'll accept one customer-initiated external pen test per year, require a statement of scope in advance, and reserve the right to validate the vendor doing the test).
- Re SOC 2: include a "summary of scope" rather than the full report in the exhibit; if Helix needs the full report we will provide a redacted copy subject to an NDA and limited distribution.
- Evidence cadence: legal prefers "reasonable cooperation" language but procurement asked for specific windows — I include both: a default quarterly evidence window and an escalation path (emergency requests subject to review and an agreed SLA).

Please review the attached PDF and let me know which of the procurement asks we can commit to verbatim vs. where we need gating language. I put comments on the notice windows (30 vs. 60 days) and suggested 30 days for scheduling external tests, 14 days for internal staging tests that affect customer-owned environments.

Laura Bennett
Associate General Counsel — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Helix_MSA_redlines_naomi_20260520.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — security exhibit and pen-test cadence (action items & next steps)

Daniel / team — thanks for the patience. Attached is a single-package response: (A) SOC2 one-pager (redacted summary), (B) proposed Order Form appendix with redlines and comments, (C) an operational note on evidence cadence and retention. Key decisions we need from Helix:

1) Pen-test scheduling window: accept Redwood's proposed standard of 30 days' notice for external tests and 14 days for internal staging tests?
2) Evidence cadence: we can commit to quarterly evidence windows and a 2-business-day turnaround for ad hoc requests related to active incidents; emergency forensic access will be triaged separately.
3) Delivery path: SOC2 artifacts and evidence will be shared via a secured document link; for full SOC2 we require an incoming NDA.

Next steps: if you approve the three items above we will incorporate final language into the Order Form and return for your legal sign-off. I put the HubSpot deal link and the DocuSign placeholder below so procurement can attach the updated Order Form to the deal.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/RD-2026-378
DocuSign placeholder: https://docusign.com/envelope/0A1B2C3

Thanks — I suggest a short 20-minute sync if procurement/legal want to walk through the redlines. Available tomorrow 10–11am or Friday 9–11am PT.

Best regards,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Strategic GTM Partnerships — Redwood Inference
